facts.statement: Tengrisaurus was described in 2017 by Averianov and Skutschas based on several isolated vertebrae.
facts.quote: The genus was described in 2017 by Averianov & Skutschas, containing a single species, Tengrisaurus starkovi, known from several isolated vertebrae.

facts.statement: Tengrisaurus lived during the Early Cretaceous (Valanginian) in the Murtoi Formation of Russia.
facts.quote: Tengrisaurus (meaning "Tengri lizard") is an extinct genus of titanosaurian sauropod dinosaur known from the Early Cretaceous (Valanginian) Murtoi Formation of Russia.

facts.statement: Tengrisaurus was described in 2017 by Averianov and Skutschas based on three caudal vertebrae collected from the Murtoi Formation.
facts.quote: Fue descrito por Averianov y Skutschas en el 2017 con base a solo tres vértebras caudales, colectadas de la Formación Murtoi.

facts.statement: Georgi Dmitriev reported the discovery of a procoelous sauropod vertebra near Murtoy in 1960.
facts.quote: En 1960, Georgi Dmitriev informó del descubrimiento de una vértebra procoelica de saurópodo cerca de Murtoy, en la orilla occidental del lago Gusinoye, en Buriatia, en la Siberia Rusa.

facts.statement: Alexei Starkov reported finding another vertebra and more osteoderms in 1992.
facts.quote: En 1992 , Alexei Starkov informó del descubrimiento de otra vértebra y más osteodermos.

facts.statement: Pavel Skutschas found another sauropod vertebra at the same site in 1998.
facts.quote: En 1998 , Pavel Skoetsjas encontró otra vértebra de saurópodo en el mismo sitio.

facts.statement: A fourth sauropod vertebra was excavated at the same location in 1999 with the help of G. I. Sazonov.
facts.quote: En 1999, con la ayuda de G. I. Sazonov, excavó una cuarta vértebra de saurópodo en el mismo lugar.

facts.statement: The genus name Tengrisaurus means "Tengri lizard" and honors Tengri, the main god of the Mongols, while the species name honors Starkov.
facts.quote: El nombre del género se deriva de Tengri, el principal dios de los mongoles, el nombre de la especie honra a Starkov.

facts.statement: Tengrisaurus was the first dinosaur named from Transbaikalia and the first sauropod named from Russia.
facts.quote: Fue el primer dinosaurio en ser nombrado del Transbaikalia y el primer saurópodo de Rusia.

facts.statement: The anterior sacral vertebrae have anterior articular processes oriented horizontally.
facts.quote: Las vértebras sacras anteriores tienen procesos articulares anteriores orientados anteriormente orientados horizontalmente.

facts.statement: Pre-epipophyses extend anteriorly beyond the articular facets at the bases of the anterior articular processes.
facts.quote: En las bases de los procesos articulares anteriores brotan preepipófisis que se extienden anteriormente más allá de las facetas articulares.

facts.statement: The anterior sacral vertebrae possess a crest extending between the anterior articular processes that divides into two.
facts.quote: Las vértebras sacras anteriores tienen una cresta que se extiende entre los procesos articulares anteriores que se divide en dos.

facts.statement: In the middle caudal vertebrae, the posterior articular processes project far behind the anterior edge of the posterior vertebral bodies.
facts.quote: En las vértebras medias de la cola, las apófisis articulares posteriores sobresalen muy por detrás del borde anterior de los cuerpos vertebrales posteriores.

facts.statement: The neural spines of the anterior and middle caudal vertebrae project obliquely backward or are positioned horizontally.
facts.quote: Las apófisis espinosas de las vértebras anteriores y medias de la cola sobresalen oblicuamente hacia atrás o se encuentran en posición horizontal.

facts.statement: The bone of the caudal vertebrae is massive.
facts.quote: El hueso de las vértebras de la cola es masivo.

facts.statement: In 2021, a unique autapomorphy was identified: a high, triangular plate-like crest on anterior caudal vertebrae that projects downward, separating the posterior hump from the rest of the vertebral body.
facts.quote: En 2021, se identificó una autapomorfía , un rasgo derivado único. En las vértebras anteriores de la cola, una cresta alta, en forma de placa triangular que sobresale hacia abajo, separa la joroba posterior del resto del cuerpo vertebral.

facts.statement: In 2025, Averianov and colleagues included a newly described cervical vertebra in their phylogenetic analysis of Tengrisaurus.
facts.quote: In their 2025 publication on Tengrisaurus, Averianov and colleagues incorporated the newly-described cervical vertebra as part of the scoring for this taxon in their phylogenetic matrix, derived from that published by Poropat et al. (2023).

facts.statement: Tengrisaurus lived during the mid-Cretaceous, between 127 and 119 million years ago (Barremian to Aptian), in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, entre 127 a 119 millones de años, desde el Barremiense al Aptiense, en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: The fossil record indicates Tengrisaurus lived from 137.05 to 132.6 million years ago during the Valanginian.
facts.quote: Time range: Valanginian to Valanginian (137.05 to 132.6 million years ago)

facts.statement: The holotype ZIN PH 7/13 was found in a layer of the Murtoj Formation dating to approximately 125 million years ago (Barremian to Aptian).
facts.quote: El holotipo, ZIN PH 7/13, se ha encontrado en una capa de la Formación Murtoj que data del Barremiense al Aptiense, aproximadamente 125 millones de años.

facts.statement: The vertebrae were found up to six meters apart.
facts.quote: Las vértebras se encontraron hasta seis metros de distancia.

facts.statement: It cannot be proven that the vertebrae belong to the same individual, but this was considered probable.
facts.quote: No se puede probar que pertenecen al mismo individuo, pero eso se consideró probable.

rejected.statement: Based on vertebra size, Tengrisaurus was not a very large sauropod, with body length estimated at 10 to 12 meters and weight at 5 to 10 tons.
rejected.quote: Dado el tamaño de las vértebras, Tengrisaurus no podría haber sido un saurópodo muy grande. En comunicados de prensa, la longitud del cuerpo se estimó entre 10 a 12 metros, esto indica un peso de cinco a diez toneladas.

rejected.statement: Tengrisaurus is an anatomically derived member of the clade Colossosauria.
rejected.quote: Despite being among the oldest named definitive titanosaurs, it is an anatomically derived member of the clade Colossosauria.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'is an anatomically derived member of the clade'

rejected.statement: Phylogenetic analysis places Tengrisaurus as the sister taxon to the clade formed by Rinconsauria and Lognkosauria within Colossosauria, diverging after Epachthosaurus.
rejected.quote: Similar to the results of Averianov et al. (2021), Tengrisaurus was recovered in a position diverging after Epachthosaurus, as the sister taxon to the clade formed by Rinconsauria and Lognkosauria within a more broadly-defined Colossosauria comprising all titanosaurs more closely related to Patagotitan than Saltasaurus.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'as the sister taxon to the clade formed'

rejected.statement: Tengrisaurus is characterized by strongly procoelous anterior and middle caudal vertebrae, strongly developed pre-epipophyses, highly pneumatic neural spines, and solid centra bone structure.
rejected.quote: Tengrisaurus is characterized by strongly procoelous anterior and middle caudal vertebrae (diagnostic of lithostrotians) with strongly developed pre-epipophyses, highly pneumatic neural spines, and solid bone structure of the centra.
